knowledge.text: Yes. Rockstar makes them the most famous attraction of Grassrivers, Leonida’s swamps, and the official screenshots show some swimming around airboats. The same text warns that far more dangerous predators live in the mangroves, without naming them. Nothing has been published about alligator attacks or alligator hunting.
knowledge.status: Answer from the “Animals” FAQ, sources at the bottom of the page

knowledge.q: Which animals can you hunt in GTA 6?
knowledge.text: Rockstar hasn’t said. Mount Kalaga is presented as hunting grounds, and Rob Nelson, quoted by creator TGG, explains that hunting makes money. The screenshots show armed hunters in the forest and, in Grassrivers, an alligator and a wild cat brought back to the dock. No species is confirmed as game.
knowledge.status: Answer from the “Animals” FAQ, sources at the bottom of the page

knowledge.q: Are there sharks and marine animals?
knowledge.text: Yes, according to Michael Kane: several species of sharks, whales, rays, turtles and jellyfish, each with its own way of moving, plus manatees. The images already show dolphins in Trailer 1 and a sea turtle among reef fish in the Keys.
